voice_trial.note: KEPT 2026-11-15 by the owner's choice (trial ended early): every English video uses Prashant's cloned voice. Only the owner changes this; the script run never reverts it. If the clone fails at render, that video falls back to the stock voice in 'voices'.

delivery_note: Scene 'delivery' is one of: warm, curious, lean-in, build, reveal, light, serious (factory/tts.py DELIVERY). Keep styles short: Google says long style text makes the voice drift.

engagement.note: Prashant 2026-11-13: hook people in the first ~2 s and keep them (open loop, mid re-hook, late payoff); end every video with a guess about TOMORROW's topic; the first 3 right answers (across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) get their names on screen in the next video. youtube_brand.name: Oh That's Why
youtube_brand.channel_description:
Oh That's Why: everyday things explained in under a minute.

You see these things every day and never think twice about them. The brush on the escalator. The tiny hole in a pen cap. The little pocket in your jeans.

Every video takes one of them and shows you the real reason it’s there. Under a minute, no boring lectures, just “oh, that’s why!”

New Short every day at 7 PM IST.

Got something you’ve always wondered about? Drop it in the comments and it might be our next video.

Prefer Hindi? Watch us at @ohthatswhy.hindii
youtube_brand.video_line: Oh That's Why: one everyday mystery explained, every day at 7 pm IST.
